QUOTE: `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c` (around line 572) is an optional built-in arena allocator, enabled by `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C`. Its `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` itself, installing its own calloc and free.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator and its init function installing itself via the runtime setter. It frames this as the library's use of the facility but doesn't use the words "only in-tree user", which the item's substance doesn't hinge on.
